click_id.description: Affiliate click ID (only for affiliate purchases)

created_by_id.description: User ID of the sales team member who created the order. Only set for orders attributed to a sales team (phone orders and orders assigned to a sales team); empty string otherwise.

created_by_name.description: Username of the sales team member who created the order ("Purchase created by" in the purchase overview). Only set for orders attributed to a sales team; empty string otherwise. Not returned to joint venture partners without order-detail rights.

payplan_id.description: ID of the payment plan the order was placed on (`payment_plan.id`); empty string when the order was not placed on a payment plan. Identifies the same payment plan the IPN reports for the purchase. Usually one of the plans listPaymentPlans returns for the order's main product, but not guaranteed - plans deleted since the order was placed are no longer listed there, and a small share of orders reference a plan belonging to another product. Not returned to joint venture partners without order-detail rights.

sub_ids.description: Affiliate sub IDs (only for affiliate purchases)

description: Read products, buyers, orders, transactions, payouts and sales settings.

digistore24_new_buyer_trigger.description: Runs for each new buyer in Digistore24. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, address_id, created_at, email, first_name, last_name, salutation, title, company, street, street_name, street_number, zipcode, city, state, country, phone_no

digistore24_new_product_trigger.description: Runs for each new product in Digistore24. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, created_at, modified_at

digistore24_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each new transaction in Digistore24. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, purchase_id, amount, currency, transaction_type, transaction_type_msg, created_at, created_by_id, created_by_name, payplan_id, buyer.id, buyer.email, buyer.first_name, buyer.last_name

digistore24_updated_product_trigger.description: Runs for each updated product in Digistore24. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, created_at, modified_at
